name: Roberto De Feo
original_name: ロベルト・デ・フェオ
source:
"I've heard townspeople's trouble, so I'll investigate it."

A detective of the Burlone Police.
As he is from another city, he isn't familiar with Burlone yet.
He has a strong sense of justice, and is troubled by the police's pandering towards the mafia.
